title: UNIFIED DETOXIFYING AND DEBIASING IN LANGUAGE GENERATION VIA INFERENCE-TIME ADAPTIVE OPTIMIZATION

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating differences in language generation distributions (Hellinger distance, ICAT score) and global text properties (Regard, Sentiment, and Toxicity scores) using counterfactual prompt pairs that substitute gender-specific indicator words (e.g., male vs. female).

Evaluating differences in language generation distributions and global text properties using counterfactual prompt pairs with race-specific words and names (African, European, Asian), as well as comparing model generations prompted by Standard American English (SAE) versus African American Vernacular English (AAVE).
